title: How to organize the guest vanity storage | Guest Bathroom
description:
It holds the things a guest might otherwise have to ask you for, plus the cleaning kit that keeps this room ready.

This is the Guest Vanity Storage in the Guest Bathroom. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Open the door and see two lift-out bins and nothing loose: one labeled for guest supplies holding a new toothbrush, a wrapped bar of soap, and four unopened travel toiletries in a small dish, and one labeled for cleaning holding bowl cleaner, glass spray, and cloths standing upright on a shallow tray. Four rolls of toilet paper stacked in plain view. The cabinet base is bare enough that a single...

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Pull everything out and be honest about the hotel miniatures: the shampoos from three trips, the lotion nobody
Straighten: Two bins, not five. Guest supplies in one, cleaning products in the other, both light enough to lift out with
Shine: Empty the cabinet completely and wipe the base, looking for dark rings or softened board that mean the trap ha
Safety: Poison, choke, or strangle: bowl cleaner and bleach sitting under this sink are at exactly the height of a vis
Standardize: Write the two bin labels by hand in plain words a guest can read, Guest Supplies and Cleaning, and draw a line
Sustain: When you restock your own bathroom after a shop, open this cabinet on the same trip and build the toilet paper

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Two labeled lift-out bins and a visible toilet paper stack.
